newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi fortnightly T-Bill rate drops to 19.16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malawi fortnightly T-Bill rate drops to 19.16 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury Bills dropped to 19.16 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 19.83 percent, the Reserve Bank said on Monday.
Applications for 279.96 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 200.45 million kwacha at an average price of 96.01 kwacha percent.

The average rate for six-month bills dropped to 19.51 percent from the previous 20.83 percent. Applications for 168.45 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 102.33 million kwacha at an average price of 90.63 kwacha percent.

For nine-month bills, the average rate dropped to 20.18 from an earlier 20.37. No subscriptions were offered for this category two weeks ago. Applications for 80.53 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 61.25 million kwacha at an average 86.04 kwacha percent.
